scope: Inverse cross-join of the shipped Lua corpus against manifests/lua_api_index.json. For each underscore-prefixed identifier the corpus references but is NOT in the 387-API catalog, classify as script_defined (Lua helper, found on assignment LHS in some script), lua_stdlib (Lua 5.1 metatable method), or candidate_missed_napi (only ever called, never defined - suggests an engine binding we did not catalogue).
